name: GitBonsai

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Window background, graph area. Warm paper or dark bark.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Sidebar, toolbar, tab row, status line.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, sheets, input fields, cards in the detail panel.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row in sidebar and graph (moss with alpha over surface-0/1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Separators, table borders, input field borders. Never pure grey.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, commit subjects, labels. On surface-0, surface-1, surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: author, date, counts, tooltips. On surface-0 to surface-2 (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Dimmed commits outside the current branch, placeholders. Only for text ≥ 13 px on surface-0 (≈ 4.5:1 light).

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Primary accent: buttons, links, active tab, focus, checked-out branch. Text on surface-0 light ≥ 5:1; in dark as a fill with on-moss.

tokens.name: on-moss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on moss fills.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success hints, badges, hover on primary actions.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Secondary accent (clay bowl): worktree marks, emphasis of crafting actions such as rebase. As text on surface-0 ≥ 4.5:1.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Background for worktree badges and the rebase banner.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Warning: untracked files, force-push hints, stale upstreams. Text on surface-0.

tokens.name: ochre-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning banners.

tokens.name: search-highlight
tokens.usage: Ground behind the matching text of the commit search in the history. Stronger than ochre-soft so that it stays visible on a selected row; text on it in ink.

tokens.name: persimmon
tokens.usage: Danger: conflicts, discard, deleting a branch, error output. Text on surface-0.

tokens.name: persimmon-soft
tokens.usage: Background for conflict banners and error rows.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Information: remote hints, fetch status, links in help text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2 px, outside; ≥ 3:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: strand-moss
tokens.usage: Graph strand 1. Strand colours cycle; in dark mode deliberately muted (less chroma), because saturated colours are too loud on bark. Labels use the strand colour as a 16 % tint with a border, never as a solid fill.

tokens.name: strand-persimmon
tokens.usage: Graph strand 2.

tokens.name: strand-plum
tokens.usage: Graph strand 3.

tokens.name: strand-sky
tokens.usage: Graph strand 4.

tokens.name: strand-ochre
tokens.usage: Graph strand 5.

tokens.name: strand-rose
tokens.usage: Graph strand 6.

tokens.name: strand-pine
tokens.usage: Graph strand 7.

tokens.name: strand-lavender
tokens.usage: Graph strand 8.

tokens.name: strand-apricot
tokens.usage: Graph strand 9.

tokens.name: strand-teal
tokens.usage: Graph strand 10.

tokens.name: strand-berry
tokens.usage: Graph strand 11.

tokens.name: strand-olive
tokens.usage: Graph strand 12.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Commit subjects, lists, dialog text. The macOS standard size.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Checked-out branch, HEAD commit, active worktree.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Author, date, counts, status line, tooltips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section titles in the sidebar and column headers, in capitals.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Heading of empty tabs and empty states.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The GitBonsai wordmark in onboarding, About and the website. Never in the working interface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Website headings, empty states with the bonsai image.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Diffs, the command line in the status line, SHAs, paths.

styles.name: sha
styles.usage: Short SHAs in lists and tooltips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and text, vertical inner padding of pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar indentation, gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet padding, gap between groups in settings.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty states, onboarding.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Row height in the graph (24 px avatar plus 5 px band gap); sidebar lists are 26 px.

tokens.name: lane
tokens.usage: Distance between two lanes in the graph; wide enough for round branch curves.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Stash nodes, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, input fields, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, banners, cards in the detail panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, onboarding cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Ref labels, badges, counts.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons, focused input fields.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips.

stroke.note: Stroke widths. Everything with round caps.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Separators, the line from label to node.

tokens.name: stroke-strand
tokens.usage: Graph strands and ring nodes.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: All icons, including the bonsai glyphs.

tokens.name: node
tokens.usage: Diameter of a commit node (avatar in the strand ring).

tokens.name: elbow
tokens.usage: Height of the S transition at a lane change in the graph; outside it the strand runs straight.

tokens.name: icon-small
tokens.usage: Glyphs in tabs, pills, list rows, toasts and the diff header.

tokens.name: icon-regular
tokens.usage: Glyphs in panel rows, the operation banner and the rebase steps.

tokens.name: icon-large
tokens.usage: Larger glyphs of single components, through their namespace.

wash.note: Alpha of ink washes for hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: wash-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on tabs, list rows and pills.

tokens.name: wash-hover-strong
tokens.usage: Hover on the active tab.

tokens.name: wash-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of rows and bare buttons.

tokens.name: wash-guide
tokens.usage: Column dividers while dragged.

tokens.name: focus-dimmed
tokens.usage: Alpha of rows and lanes outside the focus, such as commits a search does not match.

scope: Shared scales of the design language. DesignTokens.swift (Theme) mirrors every scale here; sizes that belong to one component live only in its namespace there (Theme.Tabs, Theme.Sidebar, Theme.Graph, …).
